settings.turn_help:
📘 How LAN QR, STUN, and TURN work:

1. Same Wi-Fi (QR Code / Short URL):
No TURN server needed! Start the LAN host in Match Setup — DeckBox automatically picks your real Wi-Fi IP (e.g. 192.168.x.x) and shows the short URL http://<IP>:8080. If the page doesn't open on your phone: (a) pause any VPN or pick the right Wi-Fi IP from the dropdown, (b) allow ports 8080 & 8081 in Windows Firewall.

2. Online over the Internet (STUN — active by default):
STUN (Google & Cloudflare) helps two PCs discover their public address for direct P2P connections.

3. When do I need a TURN server?
Strict routers or cellular networks (Symmetric NAT) may block direct P2P. A TURN server relays encrypted packets as a bridge. Enter free credentials (e.g. Metered OpenRelay, Cloudflare Calls) or your own coturn server here.

gallery.mod_help_btn: ℹ How Modules & Online Play Work
gallery.mod_help_text:
📦 How External Game Modules & Online Play Work:

1. Install & Load Modules:
Place a community or custom .pck or .zip cartridge module anywhere on disk and click 'Load Module'. DeckBox automatically registers it in the scalable Game Gallery above so you can launch it anytime.

2. Web-Lite Smartphone Join (Zero Install):
External & built-in cartridges run host-authoritatively in DeckBox. Friends on smartphones/browsers only scan the QR code or open http://<IP>:8080 without installing the module.

3. Online P2P Play:
For online matches over the internet, every Desktop peer loads the matching module (.pck) and passes the automatic Version & Rules Hash Handshake. Configure a TURN server under ⚙ Settings if routers block direct P2P.

ui.gallery.mod_help_only:
📦 EXTERNAL GAME MODULES (.pck / .zip)

• Load custom or community card games directly as .pck or .zip from the module slot.
• Valid cartridges register automatically in the game gallery.
• Create custom cards & card designs in '🎨 Pack Editor' and share them via .cardpack or .json export/import.
ui.gallery.online_help_only:
🌐 SETTING UP ONLINE & LAN PLAY

1. Same Wi-Fi (Phone / Tablet / PC):
   • Click 'Start LAN / QR Host' in Match Setup.
   • Scan the QR code or enter the short URL (e.g. http://192.168.x.x:8080).
   • Reassign player / table display roles in the Lobby Roster.

2. Over the Internet (P2P / TURN):
   • STUN is active by default. For strict NAT/mobile networks, configure a TURN relay in '⚙ Settings'.
